commits.body: createReviewService took DEFAULT_STATE_DIR, so test boots wrote into the real state dir. ProcessBase now carries the process's stateDir.

commits.subject: fix(runtime): the unknown-workflow sweep spares workflows another named process serves
commits.body:
Each named process records its workflows in process_workflows on every sweep; a down process keeps its runs waiting,
a workflow a redeploy drops is released after the grace period. The host passes its process name.

commits.subject: fix(usage): quarantine a step that fails alone, version raw.scores against stale writes, stop drain on close; drop installFlush and requeue
fix(check): the work-tree probe reads git in LC_ALL=C; check-real tests no longer depend on the host's env
commits.body:
Under agw check git answered in German, so a non-repo was a step failure, not invalid input. The credentials test
grepped for AGW_, which the host passes legitimately (AGW_PORT); it now greps its own leak markers.

commits.subject: fix(host): remove the dead Argo overview and review-stats pushes (#157)
commits.body:
Argo dropped its /agents/* API (its AGENTS.md says so), so every push since
2026-10-28 answered 404 and logged ~8 lines each. Nothing consumes the data, so
the push, its timers, AGW_ARGO_PUSH, ARGO_URL/ARGO_API_SECRET refs and the code
only the push used (weeklyReviewStats, onSubmitted, pgRunPurpose, the overview
push effect) are deleted, and the docs say so.

commits.subject: fix(audio): the master step passes its signal to ffmpeg; a poll failure never retries into a second prediction; document the new limits
fix(host): check env drops the whole GIT_CONFIG_COUNT/KEY_n/VALUE_n family
commits.body: The _KEY credential pattern stripped GIT_CONFIG_KEY_n but kept the count and values, so git exited 128 ('missing config key') and check and eval failed on any host whose environment carries git config.

commits.subject: fix(eval): review of #131
commits.body:
- the audio tree never aborts the host's boot: a missing dir warns, a failing discovery errors, each naming the path
- a module with a suite and no foreign() fails discovery; foreign() is computed once and reused
- two foreign modules with one id, or a foreign id a host module is named by, fail before any create() runs
- a foreign case run pending past 10 min is that case's error; a run finished under another version is not scored
- shells satisfy the workflow definition type; a test pins the served workflows to shell plus run/concurrency

commits.subject: fix(gateway): callers of /health read a 503 degraded body; the gateway log shipper redacts secrets
commits.body: eval.mine --auto, opencode-safe and verify.sh treated any non-2xx as an unreadable gateway; a 503 no-eligible-pool body still carries the pools (eval.mine: no credit; opencode-safe: IU still serves, checked on the HTTP status too). The gateway's log shipper gets a small local redactor for bearer tokens, sk- keys and URL passwords.

commits.subject: fix(deploy): the host LaunchAgent runs as an Interactive process, so its git helpers are not starved under load (#140)
commits.body:
launchd's default ran the host at scheduling priority 20 against 31 for a shell. The same 20-commit
agw review covered took 2 s from a shell and 15-40 s through the host at load 40.

commits.subject: fix(eval): review of #130
commits.body:
- speech-roundtrip: only ASCII digit runs are numbers; other numerals stay words (no NaN recursion)
- podcast.produce files no brain note for purpose eval; an unknown purpose posts no failure notice
- speech-roundtrip: the duration probe is its own step, so a probe failure keeps the paid synthesis
- stepUsage moves to src/step-usage.ts

commits.subject: fix(factory-fix-classes): a reason over 240 characters is clipped to the factory's contract instead of failing the answer
commits.body:
The workflow allowed 300 characters while the factory parses at 240, so one long reason cost a repo its whole answer.
The model's reason may now be any single line up to a sanity cap; the capability clips it at a word boundary with an
ellipsis, the output schema and the prompt say 240.

commits.subject: fix(docs): a command in the quick start carried a flag the CLI never had
fix(factory): the steward is never to raise a Decision for a lead that is gone
fix(test): the gate drain tests wait for the call to be in flight, not a 50 ms sleep, and settle their request inside the test
commits.body:
Under load the request had not reached the gate after 50 ms: close() found nothing in flight, the ledger stayed
empty, and the orphaned fetch's reset failed the next test. The drain test now waits for the fake capability to
start; the engine-end test waits until the fake engine holds the job, and cuts a SLOW (11 s) job instead of a
300 ms one, so the cut cannot race the job's end. Both await their request before the gate stops.
